title: In God I Trust

questions.question: Be gracious to me, O God, for man does what to me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:1 (ESV): "Be gracious to me, O God, for man tramples on me; all day long an attacker oppresses me;"

questions.question: When I am afraid, I put my trust in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:3 (ESV): "When I am afraid, I put my trust in you."

questions.question: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I shall not be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:4 (ESV): "In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I shall not be afraid."

questions.question: What can flesh do to me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:4 (ESV): "...what can flesh do to me?"

questions.question: All day long they injure my cause; all their thoughts are against me for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:5 (ESV): "All day long they injure my cause; all their thoughts are against me for evil."

questions.question: They stir up strife, they lurk; they watch my steps, as they have waited for my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:6 (ESV): "...as they have waited for my life."

questions.question: For their crime will they escape? In wrath cast down the peoples, O what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:7 (ESV): "For their crime will they escape? In wrath cast down the peoples, O God!"

questions.question: You have kept count of my tossings; put my tears in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:8 (ESV): "You have kept count of my tossings; put my tears in your bottle."

questions.question: Are they not in your what? (referring to his tears/tossings)
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:8 (ESV): "...Are they not in your book?"

questions.question: This I know, that God is for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:9 (ESV): "This I know, that God is for me."

questions.question: I must perform my vows to you, O God; I will render what to you?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:12 (ESV): "I must perform my vows to you, O God; I will render thank offerings to you."

questions.question: For you have delivered my soul from death, yes, my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:13 (ESV): "...that I may walk before God in the light of life."

questions.question: This Psalm was written when the Philistines seized David in where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56 Title: "...when the Philistines seized him in Gath."

questions.question: Then my enemies will turn back in the day when I do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:9 (ESV): "Then my enemies will turn back in the day when I call."

questions.question: In God I trust; I shall not be afraid. What can man do to me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 56:11 (ESV): "...what can man do to me?"

key_verse_text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.
